text.tspan: 01 THE SYSTEM — follow a document in, then an answer back
One Python process · FastAPI + RAG services
Messages and evidence live in the backend.
Text leaves this machine for API calls.
API key stays on the backend.
Ready files only · copied evidence survives deletion · two stores, no shared transaction
Your original data-flow sketch, kept intact.
Time runs downward. Save first; send complete afterward.
SSE: start → sources → answer_delta → debug → complete
Stop aborts the request. EOF without complete is an interruption.
Startup: .env → data lock → storage → recovery → SDKs
CLI and evals call the same Python services.
Delete: exclude → remove vectors → remove rows
Upload waits for indexing; no background worker.
Implemented local TXT MVP · Source map and detailed contracts: mvp-system-design.md · Architecture baseline: abd2e47
